name: A Little Fire
summary:
Embark on an epic Journey and protect your fire. 

A little fire puts you in the shoes of your favorite heroes and villains. The first story puts us in the shoes of a fallen Norse god. Unlock and wield the powers of the gods and experience a procedural roguelike like no other.

Play through the story mode to unlock Valhalla mode for the ultimate roguelike power wielding experience.
